# AI-Powered Website Design

## System Overview
Neon Vision implements autonomous systems to architect mobile-first, SEO-optimized digital platforms. Pixel-perfect initial drafts are generated within 48 hours using AI-assisted coding and design frameworks.

## Optimization & Integration
- **SEO & GEO Integration**: Incorporates FAQ/HowTo schema, Core Web Vitals, and GEO for indexing in ChatGPT, Gemini, and DeepSeek.  
- **UI/UX & Layout**: Predictive UX scoring and AI-driven landing page testing with heatmap analysis.  
- **Compatibility**: All builds meet mobile-first standards, scoring 95+ on Google’s Mobile-Friendly Test.

## Predictive Analytics & Advanced Architecture
- **User Engagement Forecasting**: Predictive AI estimates campaign outcomes with 90% accuracy.  
- **Self-Healing Systems**: Detects and fixes workflow or API errors autonomously.  
- **Autonomous Code Generation**: Tools like Cursor AI implement features 4.2x faster by interpreting intent.
